proposals.evidence: CDIAL 11348.1 *varta explicitly gives Kalasha bat, Bshk. baṭ, Torwali bāṭ and northern baṭh/baṭṭh “stone”, with aspiration noted as unexplained in the source itself. The round-stone family also includes Punjabi vaṭṭā/baṭṭā; unexplained initial bh and a pestle specialization remain separate audit questions. The comparative family link retains uncertainty about transfer between Indo-Aryan languages.
